china_race_dynamics.text:
China isn’t waiting for us to finish our Green Agenda fights and debates. 

They’re building the infrastructure, the tech, and the AI to run the world by 2030.

The real question:

Have we already lost the lead? @JMichaelWaller https://t.co/puvT1tc6hk

deepseek.reason: The speaker warns that China is racing ahead in AI and infrastructure and asks whether the U.S. has lost the lead.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly frames U.S. AI policy around competitive urgency with China.
